s: This jacket is ___.（选择正确形式）
o: heavier than that one|heavy than that one|heaviest than that one|more heavy than that one
e: than 前面要用比较级，heavy 变 heavier，把 y 改成 i 再加 -er；heavy 是原形，heaviest 是最高级，more heavy 是错误说法。

s: 你想告诉同学“我的书包比你的重”，说：（  ）
o: My schoolbag is heavy than yours.|My schoolbag is heavier than yours.|My schoolbag is more heavy than yours.|My schoolbag is heaviest than yours.
e: 比较书包轻重用比较级 heavier，后面接 than yours；heavy 是原形，more heavy 多加了 more，heaviest 是最高级，都不能跟 than 连用。

s: “Lucy is younger than Lily.” 与哪一句意思相同？（  ）
o: Lucy is older than Lily.|Lily is younger than Lucy.|Lily and Lucy are the same age.|Lily is older than Lucy.
e: Lucy 比 Lily 小，反过来就是 Lily 比 Lucy 大，所以 older than 意思相同；另外两句把年龄方向说反了，最后一句说两人同岁，也不对。

s: 下面这句哪里说错了：“My hair is more long than yours.”（  ）
o: 把 more long 改成 longest|把 more long 改成 longer|把 than 改成 to 才对|把 yours 改成 your 才对
e: long 是单音节词，比较级直接加 -er，不能用 more long；longest 是最高级，than 后面接比较对象不能换成 to，yours 表示你的头发，本身没错。

s: — Which is bigger, your bedroom or your study? — ___（选择正确回答）
o: My bedroom is big than my study.|My bedroom is bigger to my study.|My bedroom is bigger than my study.|My bedroom is more big than my study.
e: 问两者哪个更大，回答要用比较级 bigger，并用 than 引出比较对象。big 是原形，to 不能代替 than，more big 也不是正确形式。

s: 把 “The red kite is big. The blue kite is small.” 合成一句，正确的是（  ）
o: The red kite is big than the blue one.|The blue kite is bigger than the red one.|The red kite is biggest than the blue one.|The red kite is bigger than the blue one.
e: 两句合一句要比大小，big 变 bigger，后面用 than the blue one 代替 the blue kite。big 没变比较级，方向说反，biggest 是最高级，都不能和 than 搭配。

s: 下面哪一句中 than 前面的形容词形式不对（  ）
o: He is tall than his brother.|He is taller than his brother.|She is older than her sister.|She is younger than her brother.
e: than 前面要用比较级，tall 应变成 taller；tall 是原形。其余三句的 taller、older、younger 都是正确的比较级。

s: 下面哪一句的 than 用对了（  ）
o: This box is heavier to that one.|This box is heavier than that one.|This box is more heavy than that one.|This box is heaviest than that one.
e: 两者比较用 than，不用 to；heavy 的比较级是 heavier，不加 more，也不用最高级 heaviest。

s: “Tom is more taller than Jim.” 改对后是（  ）
o: Tom is tallest than Jim.|Tom is taller than Jim.|Tom is more tall than Jim.|Tom is tall than Jim.
e: taller 本身就是比较级，前面不能再加 more；tallest 是最高级，more tall 和 tall 都没有正确构成比较级。

s: 下面哪一句中 than 后面的比较对象写得对（  ）
o: My bike is newer than your.|My bike is newer than you.|My bike is newer than yours.|My bike is newer than your's.
e: 比较的是两辆自行车，than 后面用 yours 代替 your bike；your 后面缺名词，you 指人，your's 不是正确写法。

s: 下面哪一句既用了 than，又把比较级写对了（  ）
o: She is carefuller than her brother.|She is more careful to her brother.|She is more careful than her brother.|She is the most careful than her brother.
e: careful 是多音节词，比较级用 more careful，后面接 than；carefuller 拼法不对，to 不能代替 than，most careful 是最高级。

s: 下面这句改对后是：“This book is more interesting and more cheaper than that one.”（  ）
o: This book is more interesting and more cheap than that one.|This book is more interesting and cheaper than that one.|This book is interestinger and cheaper than that one.|This book is most interesting and cheapest than that one.
e: interesting 用 more 构成比较级，cheap 是单音节词，直接加 -er 变 cheaper，不能再加 more；最后一句还把两个词都写成了最高级。

s: 读句子：“The elephant is heavier than the horse.” 大象比马（  ）
e: heavier 是 heavy 的比较级，意思是更重，所以大象比马重。

s: 读句子：“Amy's ruler is longer than Ben's.” 谁的尺子长？（  ）
o: Ben 的|两根一样长|不能确定|Amy 的
e: longer than 表示比……长，Amy 的尺子比 Ben 的长，所以 Amy 的更长。

s: 读句子：“The green bag is heavier than the blue one, but it is cheaper.” 从句子看（  ）
o: 绿包比蓝包重，但便宜|蓝包比绿包重，也更贵|绿包比蓝包轻，但便宜|两个包一样重，价格不同
e: 前半句说绿包比蓝包重，后半句 but 转折，说绿包更便宜；另外几句把轻重或价格说反，或说成一样重。

s: 读句子：“My old schoolbag is small but light. The new one is big and heavy.” 从句子看（  ）
o: 旧书包小但轻|新书包又小又轻|两个书包一样大|旧书包又大又重
e: 旧书包 small but light，新书包 big and heavy，所以旧的小而轻。另外几句把大小轻重说反，或说成一样。

s: 读句子：“The new phone is bigger but more expensive, so I still use my old one.” 从句子可以知道（  ）
o: 旧手机更便宜，我还在用它|新手机更便宜，我天天用它|旧手机更大，我不喜欢它|两个手机价格一样
e: 新手机 bigger but more expensive，说明它更大也更贵；so 引出结果，我还是用旧手机，可见旧手机更便宜。

s: 读句子：“The yellow bird is smaller than the blue one. But the blue one sings more beautifully.” 从句子看（  ）
o: 黄鸟小，也唱得好|蓝鸟小，唱得差|黄鸟小，蓝鸟唱得好|两只鸟一样大
e: 前半句说黄鸟比蓝鸟小，后半句 but 转折，说蓝鸟唱得更动听，所以黄鸟小、蓝鸟唱得好。
